correctness.rationale: For k>=2, if alpha=0 then graph connectivity forces one color; hence t=alpha d is positive integer, with (k-1)t<=d. Double-counting edges between each two classes (t times either class size) forces all classes equal and thus k|2^d, hence k a power of two. For sufficiency choose r with k=2^r, use t copies of each nonzero column of F2^r and d-(k-1)t zero columns in a linear syndrome c(x)=sum x_i a_i. Each nonzero color difference occurs exactly t among one-coordinate flips, zero difference exactly s; map surjective as each basis column appears. This proves every (d,k,t) without assuming linearity of arbitrary colorings. Properness s=0 and maximal k power-of-two <=d+1 follow. Independently checked 47 permitted parameter triples d<=8 by direct neighbor histograms, while repository verify.py includes 106 construction profiles and exhaustive small labelings. All infinite assertions are proved by counting and explicit construction.

originality.rationale: In regular Q_d, FAT is exactly an equitable/perfect vertex coloring with quotient diagonal d-(k-1)t, all off-diagonal t. This equivalence was searched explicitly. Beers–Mulas arXiv:2510.18494 prove necessary balance and degree bounds, but do not state simultaneous attainment for every binary hypercube dimension/palette/tolerance. Their 2026 spectral product constructions preserve a given k rather than establish all k=2^r; Shaebani papers treat other existence families. Krotov–Valyuzhenich arXiv:2311.05566 classifies spectrally restricted perfect colorings, not this exact all-parameter iff. Syndrome/Hamming-code special cases are classical and expressly excluded from standalone novelty; no stronger all-parameter statement was found. Older coding-theoretic quotient-matrix literature remains substantive priority risk.
residual_risks: Older coding-theory and equitable-partition results could prove the uniform off-diagonal quotient spectrum, possibly with the same repeated-syndrome construction but under different terminology

value.rationale: The hypercube is a canonical graph family, and FAT colorings a well-defined mathematical invariant. This is a complete exact feasibility spectrum for all dimensions, palettes and tolerances, not a one-parameter isolated example; an explicit construction demonstrates attainability of every necessary divisibility/degree bound and identifies the properness boundary and unbounded FAT-vs-ordinary chromatic gap. While elementary, the natural classification can serve as an exact benchmark; no claim that the syndrome mechanism itself is new.

final_claim: For d>=1 and k>=2, a Fair and Tolerant k-coloring of Q_d with nonempty classes and global off-color fraction alpha exists iff k=2^r, alpha=t/d for positive integers r,t, and (k-1)t<=d; hence chi_FAT(Q_d)=2^floor(log2(d+1)), and a proper FAT coloring exists iff k=2^r and (k-1)|d.
limitations: Binary unweighted connected Q_d, d>=1; palette classes all nonempty; k=1 handled separately; complete parameter feasibility only, not all-coloring classification.
